sections.title: Story
sections.note: A new chapter opens every two days of the event.

sections.title: Death photos
sections.note: Shown when a run ends to this cause.

rows.sub:
Maiden: Patience and focus are power. That is what fishing is.
Guillotine: M-Maiden, stop the nonsense! Hurry and pull me up!
Maiden: Ah! What a catch!

rows.text: It's dark and scary in here! Save me!
rows.sub:
Maiden: U-um... There are usually items in places like this in games, so I...
Vesti: I-I see.
Maiden: Can you get me out of here?

rows: Died from a giant saw blade

rows.sub:
Guillotine: ...
Vesti: Hehe. It... It exploded...!
Guillotine: ...

Volume: Hey, can't you just jump to the side?
Guillotine: No way! A hero can only move forward!
Volume: What the...

Guillotine: It's this annoying feeling again! 
Maiden: Blasting off again!
Vesti: I-I'm flying...!

Volume: Hmm... Care to give me a hand?
Maiden: Hold on, let me write this down first. Trap ahead.

rows.text: The most powerful White Ice Dragon lets out a roar.
rows.sub:
Maiden: Attempting stop breathing. It's not. It's-it's not... It's not stopping! It's NOT!
Guillotine: WAAAAAAAAAGH!!!

sections.title: Ending photos
sections.note: Shown on the result screen for the rank you finish with.

rows.sub: Finally reached the end of the dungeon. The sun is shining.
I send praises to you, the one who came this far.

rows.text: The excellence of Nikkes is the excellence of courage!
rows.sub: Our power is the best in the world!

rows.text: Shall we go to the dungeon again?
rows.sub: In hardship and adversity, they grow stronger.
A cat walking upright might appear soon.
